title: paraconsistent-equality
description: The equality predicate on a predication hyperdoctrine, obtained as the knowledge-order Lawvere image of the constant-top valuation along the diagonal predicate specialization; it carries top on the diagonal and bottom off it, so equal entities are information-maximal while distinct ones make no claim, making it stable under knowledge-merge.

diagonalDomain.description: the diagonal sub-support Delta_E = {(s,s) : s in E} of the entity set E

image.description: Delta_E^k := exists_g^k(1_q^k): the knowledge-order Lawvere existential image of the constant-top valuation along the diagonal predicate specialization g

offDiagonal.description: Delta_E^k(s,o) = bottom when s != o (no claim)

mergeStable.description: stable under join-merge in the knowledge order, suitable for distributed and paraconsistent reasoning
